simple.meaning: אַלּוֹן (ʼallôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “oak.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H437. allon אַלּוֺן noun masculine Gen 35:8 oak ( ᵐ5 βάλανος , δρῦς , etc.) — ׳א absolute 35:8 +; construct ib. ; plural אַלּוֺנִים Amos 2:9 ; Ezek 27:6 ; construct אַלּוֺנֵי Isa 2:13 ; Zech 11:12 ; — as marking grave of Deborah, Rebekah's nurse Gen 35:8 (E); whence called oak of weeping , ׳א בָּכוּת ib. (see Di on the passage , & below אֵלוֺן p. 18); elsewhere only in prophets; as marking illicit shrines Hosea 4:13 (|| אֵלָה לִבְנֶה, ); as felled Isa 6:13 (in simile; || אֵלָה ); as furnishing material for making idols 44:14 (|| אֹרֶן תִּרְזָה, אֶרֶז, ); as simile for strength ( חסן ) Amos 2:9 ; also הַבָּשָׁן אַלּוֺנֵי Isa 2:13 (as lofty & majestic), compare Ezek 27:6 (as strong, for making oars); Zech 11:2 , metaphor of prominent men.

occurrences.englishText: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up,
If there is a tenth left in it,
He cuts down cedars for himself,
They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan.
They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains,
Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them,
Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen,
